cat > /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/5741f5c3-6397-436d-9f65-9474862aa231/scratchpad/patch6.py <<'PYEOF'
P = "tests/test_init.lua"
src = open(P, encoding="utf-8").read()

def rep(old, new, count=1):
    global src
    n = src.count(old)
    assert n == count, "anchor count %d (expected %d) for: %r" % (n, count, old[:90])
    src = src.replace(old, new, count)

# strip() is line-oriented: in a Lua pattern `.` matches newlines, so "--.*$" over a whole
# function body deletes everything after its first comment. Give the block scans their own.
rep('''local stripped = {}
for i, l in ipairs(lines) do stripped[i] = strip(l) end''',
'''local stripped = {}
for i, l in ipairs(lines) do stripped[i] = strip(l) end

-- strip() is line-oriented on purpose: in a Lua pattern `.` matches newlines, so running it
-- over a whole function body would delete everything after its first `--` comment.
local function stripBlock(text)
    local out = {}
    for line in (text .. "\\n"):gmatch("([^\\n]*)\\n") do out[#out + 1] = strip(line) end
    return table.concat(out, "\\n")
end''')

# 8f: scan the raw lines for the rm -rf (the path is inside a string literal, which strip blanks)
rep('''        local body = table.concat({ table.unpack(stripped, twStart, twEnd) }, "\\n")
        check("detach: starting a recording does not reset the pipeline",
              body:find("pipelineReset") == nil,''',
'''        local body = table.concat({ table.unpack(stripped, twStart, twEnd) }, "\\n")
        -- The wipe scan runs on the raw lines: the path it deletes lives inside a string
        -- literal, and strip() blanks those.
        local rawBody = table.concat({ table.unpack(lines, twStart, twEnd) }, "\\n")
        check("detach: starting a recording does not reset the pipeline",
              body:find("pipelineReset") == nil,''')

rep('''        for line in body:gmatch("[^\\n]+") do
            if line:find("rm %-rf") then wipes[#wipes + 1] = line end
        end''',
'''        for line in rawBody:gmatch("[^\\n]+") do
            if line:find("rm %-rf") then wipes[#wipes + 1] = line end
        end''')

rep('''          srcStart ~= nil and strip(srcStart):find("pipeStartJob") ~= nil,''',
'''          srcStart ~= nil and stripBlock(srcStart):find("pipeStartJob") ~= nil,''')

rep('''        local body = strip(dispatch)
        check("detach: dispatchSegment() captures its job instead of reading `pipe` later",''',
'''        local body = stripBlock(dispatch)
        check("detach: dispatchSegment() captures its job instead of reading `pipe` later",''')

# The startRecording behavioral test now needs the job stub.
rep('''    env.tryWarmup            = function() calls.warmup = calls.warmup + 1 end''',
'''    env.tryWarmup            = function() calls.warmup = calls.warmup + 1 end
    env.pipeStartJob         = function() calls.newJob = calls.newJob + 1 end''')

open(P, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(src)
print("patch6 ok")
PYEOF
python3 /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/5741f5c3-6397-436d-9f65-9474862aa231/scratchpad/patch6.py; grep -n "local calls" -A 10 tests/test_init.lua | sed -n '1,20p'
